title: Salt & Light

services.name: Dance Classes
services.desc: Our mission at Salt & Light is to create an inclusive, safe, and inspiring environment where all people can learn to love, appreciate, and celebrate their bodies. We strive to cultivate joy, passion, and self-expression through movement, while encouraging our students to build self-confidence and find joy in the journey. Ballet classes are offered from ages 3 to adult. Classes are taught in the classical approach with each class participating in full barre & centre exercises. Class time will be approx. 50 min to 90 min depending on class level and student placement based on abilities and experience.
